# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are made against the latest version on the default branch.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not report suspected security vulnerabilities in public GitHub Issues. Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature for this repository when available. If it is unavailable, open an issue containing only a request for a private contact channel; do not include exploit details, credentials, user data, or proof-of-concept code.

Include a concise description of the affected version, impact, and steps needed to reproduce the issue. The project maintainer will acknowledge a valid report and coordinate disclosure through a private channel.

## Scope

Examples include vulnerabilities in the macOS application, release artifact integrity, or the project build and packaging process. Availability or accuracy issues in the third-party market-data endpoint are not security vulnerabilities unless they introduce a security impact in Gold Ticker itself.
